about.description:
nrl-lib is a Python client for the Nominal Response Library (NRL) v2
web service run by EarthScope. The NRL is a curated collection of
instrument responses for seismic sensors and dataloggers. nrl-lib lets
you query it from Python instead of building service URLs by hand.

Supported queries:

- catalog: list instrument types, manufacturers, models and
  configuration parameters available in the NRL (XML, JSON or text)
- combine: build complete sensor + datalogger instrument responses,
  optionally stamped with network/station/location/channel epoch
  information, as StationXML, StationXML-Response or RESP (single
  files or .zip bundles)
- prefix-lookup: retrieve the table of instrument-configuration
  prefixes with their names and associated logic-tree questions

Responses can be returned in memory or written to files, with
configurable error handling and logging. It has no CLI or GUI and is
meant to be used as a library dependency.

Install: conda install -c conda-forge nrl-lib
Import:  from nrl.NRLQuery import NRLQuery

name: nrl-lib
raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: nrl-lib
  version: "1.0.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://gitlab.com/earthscope/public/epic/nrl-lib/-/archive/v${{ version }}/nrl-lib-v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fd0c8219f93aa4f4d9a53fd0708612929b9cf2dd0e44e339cd0d7ed0789e46ca

build:
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation
  number: 1

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools >=77
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - requests
    - pyyaml

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - nrl
        - nrl.NRLQuery
      pip_check: true
      python_version:
        - ${{ python_min }}.*
        - "*"
  - script:
      - python -m unittest discover -s tests
    requirements:
      run:
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    files:
      source:
        - tests/

about:
  homepage: https://epic.earthscope.org/content/software-resources
  repository: https://gitlab.com/earthscope/public/epic/nrl-lib
  documentation: https://gitlab.com/earthscope/public/epic/nrl-lib/-/blob/main/README.md
  license: GPL-3.0-or-later
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python client for the EarthScope Nominal Response Library (NRL) v2 web service
  description: |
    nrl-lib is a Python client for the Nominal Response Library (NRL) v2
    web service run by EarthScope. The NRL is a curated collection of
    instrument responses for seismic sensors and dataloggers. nrl-lib lets

      files or .zip bundles)
    - prefix-lookup: retrieve the table of instrument-configuration
      prefixes with their names and associated logic-tree questions

    Responses can be returned in memory or written to files, with

    Install: conda install -c conda-forge nrl-lib
    Import:  from nrl.NRLQuery import NRLQuery

extra:
